name: reach a maximum game score in the adventure
definition: complete the game in a way that attains the top achievable score in the single session.
failure_mode: finishing before earning a possible treasure/item drops the score below max

name: reach trajectory accuracy against a fine reference
definition: produce approximated values whose max absolute error versus a fine-grained numeric reference of the same rhs stays within a tolerance.
failure_mode: insufficient stepping resolution or a coarse method yields values that drift beyond the tolerance
